text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One key problem is bias. If the data used to train AI is unfair, the system can treat some groups badly. Fairness means making sure AI works well for everyone. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it safely. Transparency is important too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means designers and governments work together to create rules that protect society. In short, ethical AI needs fairness, privacy, transparency, and responsible choices from everyone involved.
